rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst, but the image does not clearly support a confidently expanded 3AA assessment; TE cohesion, symmetric expansion, and detailed zona thinning are somewhat overstated from this single view.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte yield, sperm quality, diagnosis, endometrium, and lifestyle factors with embryo prognosis.
Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a clear link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis, though some quantitative adjustments are somewhat speculative.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading, SET prognosis, and counseling, but includes weaker-evidence recommendations such as ERA/EMMA-ALICE and overstates certainty around protocol changes and alcohol effect size.
Provides clear, practical next steps for transfer counseling, lifestyle modification, luteal support considerations, and future cycle planning with alternatives discussed.
